summary: Transform your organization with our Leading Change in AI-Driven Organizations training. Equip your team with the skills to thrive in a tech-driven future.
lede: AI change management helps change, transformation, and workforce professionals guide adoption as AI reshapes workflows and roles. The course covers readiness and stakeholder assessment, resistance and communication planning, workforce role transitions, responsible AI governance, and adoption measurement, with practical exercises to create scorecards, action roadmaps, governance checklists, and dashboards that connect AI initiatives to day-to-day work.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already support change, transformation, or workforce planning and now need to lead AI-related adoption with more structure. The roles below reflect the daily work of people who manage resistance, redesign workflows, coordinate sponsors, and report progress to leadership in AI-driven organizations.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a current AI or digital transformation example from your organization, and any internal change artefacts you already use, such as stakeholder maps, communication plans, or readiness assessments. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets will help with scorecards and dashboards, but no programming is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
